rationale: Single IOM blog post on diaspora/remittances; one-off artifact and URL verification failed, so re-check liveness rather than monitor.
One-off World Bank Kosovo migration/remittances PDF; high-credibility citable baseline, not a recurring feed.
Single EU/ICMPD Kosovo factsheet PDF; convenient pre-aggregated cross-check, no ongoing signal stream.
MIA division licensing private security/CIT operators — the only route to Kosovo cash-in-transit actor data; monitor for register updates.
Static insurer product page; useful indirect reveal that a CIT market exists but produces no recurring signal.
Official Gazette search is the authoritative, continuously updated repository for payment-system and cash-handling legal change.
Aggregator republishing BQK remittance series as tidy tables; valuable change-detector while BQK is bot-defended, low credibility so always re-verify.
Serbian-language amplifier of BQK remittance releases; fills the documented sr-language coverage gap for Kosovo.
Ministry diaspora news/policy tag feed carrying registration counts and strategy shifts behind remittance flows.
Largest Kosovo job portal with dated bank card/POS/payment-systems vacancies naming internal units and platforms; cheap high-yield weak signal.
Second listing surface of the KosovaJob network with employer-exclusive payments/reporting roles; separate domain, worth its own monitor.
Independent vacancy aggregator giving redundancy for short-lived bank/PSP ads.
Third-tier job portal; may add small NBFI/fintech hiring coverage but value overlaps the stronger portals — revisit.
Bank-side primary vacancy feed naming card/ATM/e-banking systems; distinct recurring surface from the portals.
TEB corporate/careers surface identifying in-house card and POS acquiring ownership at a principal Kosovo issuer/acquirer.
BQK complaints section is one of 59 siblings on bqk-kos.org; valuable but covered by monitoring the BQK parent.
Dated board-decision notices are the earliest signal of PSP/e-money licensing and market-structure change; distinct high-value feed worth its own watch.
Regional payments conference agenda/speaker roster with Kosovo-linked figures quoting card and acquiring metrics not otherwise published.
ICT association/KosICT event site mapping who owns payments technology inside Kosovo banks; recurring annual signal.
Bank-of-the-Year Kosovo citations carry unpublished operating metrics but sit behind a paid subscription; human must clear access.
Public annual award naming a Kosovo winner with growth/innovation criteria; structured yearly metric snapshot.
Third annual Kosovo award citation stream but paywalled; requires subscription clearance before tracking.
Single news article on an EBRD TFP award; the ranking is useful evidence but the outlet page is not the producing source.
Bank LinkedIn pages pre-announce card/POS and ATM-fleet changes but require credentials; access and ToS must be cleared by a human.
Management/board roster is a seed list to mine once for the cards/digital executive watchlist, then refresh occasionally.
Investigative outlet that obtains BQK complaint breakdowns unavailable on the regulator's site; effective FOI proxy worth monitoring.
High-volume Kosovo outlet mirroring BQK/fintech event and complaint figures; dated searchable backstop.
